title: File
description: A file payload for data apps and agent sessions. Identified by `id.fileId` so other contexts (e.g. `fdc3.ai.agentQuery.fileIds`) can reference it without embedding bytes. Carry content via `content_b64` or `url` (mutually exclusive). Prefer targeted intents / PrivateChannel delivery over user-channel broadcast for large payloads.

id.title: ID
id.description: Stable identifiers. `fileId` is required for session references.

fileId.title: File ID
fileId.description: Conversation-scoped id referenced by agentQuery.fileIds and tools.

content_b64.title: Content (base64)
content_b64.description: Base64-encoded file bytes. Mutually exclusive with `url`.

url.title: URL
url.description: Fetchable URL for the file body. Mutually exclusive with `content_b64`.
